prompt: Ingest pages 1-20 of the BDA3.pdf textbook into Research/Bayesian Statistics folder. Focus on extracting all theorems, definitions, and examples with full formal statements.

assertions.name: has_theorem_callouts
assertions.description: Notes contain > [!theorem] callouts with full formal mathematical statements

assertions.name: has_definition_callouts
assertions.description: Notes contain > [!definition] callouts with formal definitions

assertions.name: has_worked_examples
assertions.description: Notes contain > [!example] callouts with complete setup, solution, and interpretation

assertions.name: enhanced_frontmatter
assertions.description: Notes have depends_on, used_by, source_location, and doc_type fields in frontmatter

assertions.name: index_routing_summary
assertions.description: Index files contain routing summaries with conditional navigation (If you need X, go to [[Y]])

assertions.name: concept_map_table
assertions.description: Index files contain a concept map table with columns for Concept, Note, Depends On, Key Result

assertions.name: multiple_atomic_notes
assertions.description: Produces 3+ separate note files rather than one monolithic note
